name: Black History
overview: Scripture reveals the diversity and dignity of God's creation, as seen in the varied colors of materials described in Esther 1:6 and the presence of leaders like Simeon called Niger in Acts 13:1, highlighting the inclusion of different peoples within the early church. God's sovereignty and holiness are portrayed with imagery such as the Ancient of Days clothed in white and pure wool (Daniel 7:9), while Deuteronomy 28:1 emphasizes God's promise to exalt those who faithfully obey His commandments above all nations. These passages collectively affirm God's authority over all peoples and the value of obedience to Him, without regard to ethnicity.
